newsitem.title: USA: Agouron tumor drug safe in healthy males.
newsitem.headline: Agouron tumor drug safe in healthy males.

text.p: Agouron Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that in a Phase I study of healthy male volunteers, AG3340 was found to be safe and well tolerated.

Agouron said that AG3340 was designed as a highly selective, nonpeptidic inhibitor of certain matrix metalloproteinases, a family of enzymes known to be involved in processes through which tumors invade tissues, metastasize, and grow.

The company also said that results from a preclinical study on its antitumor agent Thymitaq showed the drug enhanced the effectiveness of radiotherapy 260 percent in animals, and increased the tumor control rate to 90 percent from 10 percent with radiation alone.
AG3340 and Thymitaq are being developed by Agouron in collaboration with Roche Holding AG affiliate Hoffmann-La Roche Inc.
